subject: App works differently on shinyapps vis my desktop

messages.author: c5790e857463cacd
messages.subject: App works differently on shinyapps vis my desktop
parts:
Hello, 
 I am having an issue with this app again:

 https://johnpaul.shinyapps.io/VegShiny/

however, this time it is easy to repeat and I have an  a work around that might be useful for testing. The app works as expected on my desktop, the problems are only on shinyapps.

Before I had an error where if you chose "Soil Map" from the "Map Layers" box in the lower left, the app would often crash. Thanks to something done on the Rstudio end (My code had not changed) that no longer happens ever. However, there is now a new and related issue. 


Problem:
 When you chose a "Map Layer' a "Layer Legend" modal appears (it is a conditional panel) and it should display a legend. However what happens now is that the modal appears, but the legend does not. If I examine the elements in the modal using my browser I find that they are of class "shiny-html-output shiny-bound-output recalculating", whatever that means. Note, on rare occasion, the legend will appear.

Work around:

At the bottom of the map, there is a long thin modal that allows you to show or hide various parts of the interface. If you uncheck the "Layer Legend" box, then chose a map layer and let it display, and then check the "Layer Legend" box the legend will display correctly. I think what this is doing is making it so that the outputs for the map and the outputs for the Legend are not longer updating at the same time. Why that matters I have no  clue.

Thanks for your help and I have pasted my showLogs() output below:

John Paul
